g.text: An LTI system convolves in time and multiplies in frequency

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Continuous-time linear time-invariant model. The impulse response fully describes the zero-state response; any response to nonzero initial conditions must
be added separately. The arrows between rows denote transform pairs, not a physical signal-processing operation.
